title: seseli schrenkianum
intro: Seseli schrenkianum, commonly known as Schrenk's seseli, is a perennial plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and exerting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Schrenk's seseli are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes and flavonoids. Bioactive constituents of Schrenk's seseli include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its health benefits.
